title: Let launcher tests honor an explicit ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY instead of pinning target/debug
outcome: Let launcher tests honor an explicit ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY instead of pinning target/debug
acceptance: The launcher behaviour tests run in a cold worktree (no target/debug/engram.exe) when ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY names a built engram binary, and use that binary for source capture
Without ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY the tests keep their current default of <CARGO_TARGET_DIR or target>/debug/engram
